{{Infobox character|name=Scribe Alf|house=[[House Tidebreaker]]|role=Copyist|age=~40}}
'''Scribe Alf''' is the house's most industrious copyist: he transcribes every scroll faithfully, even those he is not permitted to read through, and has no opinion on any of them. A proud craftsman. The Archive could not exist without him; he has never once asked what is in it.
